errors.quote: For each $j$ let $q_j$ be the integer nearest $tj/s$
errors.problem: There is a tie when s is even and j=s/2: tj/s=t/2 is then a half-integer (t is odd), so the nearest integer is not unique. The paper fixes q_j=\lfloor tj/s+1/2\rfloor, with ties rounded upward, for 0\le j<s.

errors.quote: An approximation $\widetilde L$ of a contraction $L$ has error below a bound if $2^p\|\widetilde Lu-Lu\|$ is less than it.
errors.problem: u is not quantified and no domain is given. The paper defines \widetilde L:\mathbb D_p^a\to\mathbb D_p^b and requires the bound for every input in \mathbb D_p^a.
